```artifact
Feature: Alarms

  Scenario: Proximal tube connected
    Given the proximal tube is connected
    When the system is initialized
    Then the system reports the proximal tube is connected

  Scenario: Proximal tube disconnected
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected
    When the system is initialized
    Then the system reports the proximal tube is disconnected
    And the "proximal tube disconnected" alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is medium

  Scenario: Obstruction detected
    Given the VTI is less than 100ml
    When the system is initialized
    Then the obstruction alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is high

  Scenario: Obstruction not detected
    Given the VTI is 100ml or more
    When the system is initialized
    Then the obstruction alarm is inactive

  Scenario: Leakage computed
    Given the sensor reading is 50ml/min
    When the system is initialized
    Then the leakage is computed as 50ml/min

  Scenario Outline: Alarm priority
    Given the alarm is active
    When the system is initialized
    Then the alarm priority is <priority>

    Examples:
      | priority |
      | medium   |
      | high     |

  Scenario Outline: Proximal tube disconnect alarm priority
    Given the proximal tube is disconnected
    When the system is initialized
    Then the "proximal tube disconnected" alarm priority is medium

    Examples:
      | priority |
      | medium   |

  Scenario Outline: Obstruction alarm priority
    Given the VTI is less than 100ml
    When the system is initialized
    Then the obstruction alarm priority is high

    Examples:
      | priority |
      | high     |

  Scenario: Negative sensor reading
    Given the sensor reading is -1ml/min
    When the system is initialized
    Then the system reports an error

  Scenario: VTI exactly 100ml when tube disconnected
    Given the VTI is exactly 100ml and the proximal tube is disconnected
    When the system is initialized
    Then the obstruction alarm is active
    And the alarm priority is high
```
